app.name: SmartStack
app.tagline: Your supplements. Your schedule. Smarter timing.

banner.sample: Product details come from newrootsherbal.com. Timing rules are not yet reviewed and are not medical advice. Talk to a healthcare professional about your supplements.

short.WITH_FAT: Take with a meal that contains some fat

install.iosTitle: Add SmartStack to your Home Screen
install.iosIntro: On iPhone, reminders only work from the Home Screen app. Install it first, then set up your routine inside the app.
install.iosStep1: Tap the Share button in Safari (the square with an arrow).
install.iosStep3: Open SmartStack from your Home Screen.
install.iosWhy: Why first? A Home Screen app on iOS keeps its own data, separate from Safari, so anything you set up here would not carry over.
install.androidHint: Install SmartStack for quicker access. Reminders arrive even when Chrome is closed.

onboarding.title: Your daily routine
onboarding.intro: SmartStack fits your supplements around your day. You can change this any time in Settings.
onboarding.noCoffee: I don't drink coffee or tea
onboarding.mealRequired: Keep at least one meal so there is something to schedule around.

add.title: Add a supplement
add.scanHint: Point the camera at the barcode on the bottle.
add.cameraUnavailable: Camera unavailable. Enter the UPC or browse the products instead.
add.cameraDenied: Camera access was denied. Allow it in your browser settings or enter the UPC instead.
add.notFoundHint: Only New Roots Herbal natural health products are recognized. Check the code or browse the list.
add.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, SKU or UPC
add.alreadyInStack: Already in your stack — this updates how often you take it.

stack.title: My stack
stack.emptyHint: Scan a product or browse the list to get started.
stack.overlapTotal: Your total daily intake from these products is {total}.
stack.reviewBody: You're taking multiple products containing this nutrient. Consider discussing your total intake with a healthcare professional.
stack.unknownHint: This product is not in the current catalogue, so it is left out of your schedule.

today.title: Today
today.emptyHint: Add supplements to your stack to see your schedule.
today.lateIntro: Shift everything still ahead of you today. Tomorrow is back to normal.
today.adjustmentsIntro: Your schedule was rebuilt from your stack and routine.

why.title: Why?
why.sampleNote: Sample product — directions and warnings are placeholders.
why.draftNote: Label text from newrootsherbal.com; timing rules not yet reviewed.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.intro: Get a notification at each scheduled time. SmartStack sends nothing to the server until you turn this on.
reminders.statusOn: Reminders are on for this device.
reminders.deniedIos: Re-enable them in Settings → Notifications → SmartStack.
reminders.deniedAndroid: Re-enable them in Chrome: tap the lock icon in the address bar → Permissions → Notifications.
reminders.deniedDesktop: Re-enable them in your browser's site settings for this page.
reminders.unsupported: This browser can't deliver reminders. On iPhone, add SmartStack to your Home Screen and open it from there.
reminders.pushServiceFailed: Your browser could not register with its push service (the message was “{error}”). Office networks often block this channel; try a phone on mobile data or a home network. Nothing was sent to the server.
reminders.test: Send me a test reminder in 2–3 minutes
reminders.testBody: Reminders are working on this device.
reminders.testSent: Test reminder scheduled. Lock your phone and wait.
reminders.stale: Your reminders haven't been refreshed in over 5 days. Open the app now and then to keep them coming.
reminders.syncFailed: Could not reach the reminder service ({error}). It will retry next time you open the app.
reminders.vapidMissing: Reminders aren't configured on this build yet (missing public key).
reminders.windowNote: Reminders are scheduled 7 days ahead each time you open the app.
reminders.privacy: What is sent: an anonymous id, your time zone, your push subscription and the reminder times with product names. Never your routine or full stack.

settings.title: Settings
settings.timezoneNote: Detected from your device. Reminders follow it automatically.
settings.deleteConfirm: Delete your stack, routine and reminders on this device and on the server? This can't be undone.
settings.deleteFailedServer: The server could not be reached; local data was deleted anyway. Server rows expire on their own within 7 days.
settings.privacyBody: SmartStack stores your routine and stack only on this device. If you turn on reminders, the server keeps an anonymous id, your time zone, your push subscription and the next 7 days of reminder times with product names. Sent reminders are deleted after 7 days. Nothing is shared with third parties and there are no analytics.
settings.catalogue: Catalogue: {count} New Roots Herbal products imported from newrootsherbal.com

dev.barcodesIntro: Search a product and scan its barcode off the screen. Real products render as UPC-A; sample codes use GS1 prefix 200.
